text: Advanced artificial judicial intelligence capable of simulating full judicial processes remains speculative, and its feasibility is limited by ethical concerns including bias and accountability rather than by technical capability alone.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Morgan A. Gray, The Evolving Role of Artificial Intelligence in Law (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5541658

isBasedOn.name: The Evolving Role of Artificial Intelligence in Law

abstract: While current systems, like the Dutch court's traffic violation appeals tool, show promise, AAJI's feasibility is limited by ethical concerns, including bias and accountability.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: full automation of judicial processes as opposed to decision support
